answer: Schneider Electric targets by 2030 a 90% absolute reduction in Scope 1 and 2 versus 2017 and a 25% absolute reduction in Scope 3 versus 2021; the corresponding 2030 absolute values are 70,096 and 51,382,759 tCO2e. By 2050 it targets a net-zero value chain and 90% absolute GHG reduction versus 2021, with absolute values of 29,207 tCO2e for Scope 1 and 2 and 6,851,035 tCO2e for Scope 3. The targets cover all GHGs and applicable sources in their scopes, use market-based Scope 2, exclude carbon credits inside the value chain and avoided emissions from sold offers, and were approved by SBTi in 2022.

normalized_value.coverage: all GHGs and all applicable emissions sources under the respective scopes
normalized_value.exclusions: carbon credits inside the value chain and avoided emissions from sold offers
